# Arterial Supply

# Venous supply

- Divided into **superficial** and *deep** territories @blumenfeldNeuroanatomyClinicalCases2022
    - Superficial veins drain into the *superior sagittal sinus* and *cavernous sinus* @blumenfeldNeuroanatomyClinicalCases2022
    - **Deep territory** drains into the *great vein of galen*

Regardless of territory, nearly all venous drainage of the brain drains into the *internal jugular veins* @blumenfeldNeuroanatomyClinicalCases2022.

- The *superior sagittal sinus* drains posteriorly into the left and right *transverse sinuses* @blumenfeldNeuroanatomyClinicalCases2022
- The left and right *transverse sinuses* turn downward to unionize and become the *sigmoid sinus* @blumenfeldNeuroanatomyClinicalCases2022
- Sigmoid sinus
    - Exits the skull via the *jugular foramen*
